Save a sashimi figure

Source: R/plot-sashimi.R
save_sashimi.Rd

A thin wrapper over ggplot2::ggsave() that defaults the height to the one the panel stack wants - 0.95 inches per coverage panel plus 2.0 for the annotation - and picks a device from the file extension.

Usage

save_sashimi(plot, file, width = 5.9, height = NULL, dpi = 300, ...)

Arguments

plot

A plot from plot_sashimi().

file

Output path; the extension selects the device.

width

Width in inches.

height

Height in inches, or NULL to compute it.

dpi

Resolution for raster devices.

...

Passed to ggplot2::ggsave().

Value

file, invisibly.

Examples

sd <- sashimi_data(
  loci = data.frame(locus_id = "a", gene_name = "A", chrom = "chr1",
                    strand = "+", win_lo = 1, win_hi = 10),
  tracks = data.frame(locus_id = "a", group = "g", pos = 1:10, value = 1:10)
)
f <- file.path(tempdir(), "demo.pdf")
save_sashimi(plot_sashimi(sd), f)
